content: अदब्ध, -दम्भ {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] <ab>Ved.</ab> Unbroken or unimpaired, unhurt, uninjured; pure, true; ˚असु, or ˚आयुः having uninjured or pure life; leaving uninjured the man who sacrifices; ˚धीति, ˚व्रत whose works or religious observances are unimpaired. अर्यमणं भगमदब्धधीतीनच्छ <ls>Rv. 6. 51. 3</ls>.
अदम्भ {%a.%} Honest, undeceitful. .{@-भः@} .²1 Honesty, absence of deceit. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva.
